implementation.name: original-v3-vol3-sandbox-pool-lifecycle
implementation.scope: One instance, lease L1, and explicitly covered reset obligations. This is a success path; any failed or incomplete obligation requires removal from service.
implementation.question: What permits a used sandbox to return to standby?

purpose: What permits a used sandbox to return to standby?
guard: Reset covers defined guest, storage, authority, host-service, and device domains. All failure exits destroy or retire the instance. Ending a lease does not prove quiescence; guest rollback does not reverse external effects.
